description: Jernbane - Banenettverk - Lineære referanser is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bane NOR SF. Datasettet Banenettverk inneheld referanselinjer for jernbanestrekningar som er ein del av statens jernbaneinfrastruktur (samt museumsbanar) i Norge med geografisk stedfesta linjegeometri og noder i eit topologisk nettverk. Nettverket har verdiar i samsvar med Bane NOR sin modell for lineære referansar (kilometrering). Coverage: Bane NOR SF. The publisher named on the listing is Bane NOR SF. Its keywords include Jernbane, Norge digitalt, Jernbanestasjon, Samferdsel, fellesDatakatalog, National. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GDB. The listing shows 2024-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
